statement: Greenhouse plant pathogens can be introduced or moved through contaminated soil, tools, hose ends, machinery, containers, and other materials, so clean growing media and production areas should be protected from contaminated carriers.

review.rationale: Drafted from the reviewed Penn State greenhouse disease-source guidance and cross-checked against the current extension page on September 15, 2026. The statement is limited to documented contamination pathways and sanitation implications.
review.notes: Human plant-pathology/biosecurity review is required before promotion.
